title: Ambient exchange for arbitrary schemes commutes with canonical derived shifts
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and let $X'\xrightarrow{a}X$, $C\xrightarrow{c}Y$, $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to C$ form a chosen cartesian square of arbitrary schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. On the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{p_T^*\Lambda})$ use exact module inverse images, ordinary K-injective derived direct images, their canonical derived adjunctions and pullback-composition isomorphisms [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\Phi=c^*Rf_*$ and $\Psi=Rf'_*a^*$, with canonical shift isomorphisms $\xi_{n,L}:\Phi(L[n])\cong\Phi(L)[n]$ and $\zeta_{n,L}:\Psi(L[n])\cong\Psi(L)[n]$. Both functors are triangulated. The actual ambient exchange $\operatorname{Ex}:\Phi\to\Psi$ of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] satisfies, for all $n\in\mathbf Z$ and $L\in D_X$,
$$\zeta_{n,L}\circ\operatorname{Ex}_{L[n]}=(\operatorname{Ex}_L)[n]\circ\xi_{n,L}.$$
In particular, for every distinguished triangle $K_1\to K_2\to K_3\xrightarrow{w}K_1[1]$, its three exchange components form a morphism of the two image triangles, including the square involving $w$ and the displayed shift comparisons. The shift structures here are the termwise structures on exact inverse images and the canonical structures on total right derived direct images; the statement includes their compatibility with the units and counits of the specified derived adjunctions and with the localized pullback-composition square. No finite-type-over-a-field, Noetherian, properness, constructibility or boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The actual condensedAmbientExchange of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] is the mate of this square under the two specified adjunctions. Apply the proved source-library lemma CategoryTheory.NatTrans.CommShift.mateEquiv (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Shift.Adjunction). Its proof unfolds the mate into units, counits, whiskering and associators and uses exactly the closure operations [lem-weil-pbc-commshift-nattrans-comp-whisker]. Together with step 2 this proves that the actual exchange commutes with all integer shifts. NatTrans.shift_app_comm, read in the reverse direction, is the asserted component equation. No invertibility of the exchange is used.

proof.text: For a distinguished triangle T, step 1 and Functor.map_distinguished give the two distinguished image triangles. Construct their morphism with the three actual exchange components. Naturality gives its first and second squares. For its third square, rewrite the composite source shift comparison followed by the shifted exchange using step 3 at n=1 and T.obj₁. Reassociate, apply naturality at T.mor₃, and reassociate again. The three component equalities are reflexivity.

That data is the exact termwise D(u^*), the Stacks 0DVC adjunction a^A and the termwise compositors of lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition. Step 3 instead expanded it directly with the K-flat P_u and the adjunction a^P, and bridged the two in only one sentence. The fix rewrites Step 3. It identifies the definition's data and relates the squares by theta^A(c*c) = (c*c)theta (Step 1). It uses eta^A = G(c)eta^P and eps^A = eps^P c^-1 (Step 2). With the shift-compatible c_u and comp-whisker (i)-(iii), the A-data then commute with the termwise shifts. Step 4 now refers to Step 3, and proof_deps is the union of the step uses. A DFS shows the new deps make no cycle. Steps 1, 2, 4 and 5 are verified: comp-whisker applies to [n] for every n, and I checked the types in the connecting square of Step 5. I tested n=0, n=±1, the empty scheme, Lambda=0 and the identity square. Not a duplicate: lem-sfb-derived-exchange-exact-normalization is the finite-type special case (advisory), and lem-weil-pbc-derived-exchange-triangulated is the etale D^+ version.
